The 'doctrine' pass overrides the routine economy pass when it yields a step. If that tech is unaffordable or unmet-requirements, the doctrine pass offers *only* that candidate → firstQueueable returns null → the 'doctrine' pass yields nothing for that planet → then the 'storage'/'surplus'/'ambition'/'routine' passes run (buildings only) → the LAB stays idle for that login even though cheaper research exists in 'routine'?   416	     * Research is account-wide on the host's screen while its queue and its requirements are per

  418	     * names a technology: the price, the requirement graph and the queue are all the host's.

  420	    private function queueableResearch(PlanetService $planet, BuildCandidate $candidate): ?QueueableResearch
  421	    {
  422	        $machineName = ObjectService::getObjectById($candidate->buildingId)->machine_name;
  423	
  424	        // A technology already in research anywhere on the account is not offered again: the host
  425	        // would take the row and then cancel it, so the capability is withheld instead of the
  426	        // decision being spent on a refusal.
  427	        if ($this->researchQueueService->activeResearchQueueItemCount($planet->getPlayer(), $candidate->buildingId) > 0) {
  428	            return null;
  429	        }
  430	
  431	        $queueable = !$this->researchQueueService->retrieveQueue($planet)->isQueueFull()
  432	            && ObjectService::objectRequirementsMetWithQueue($machineName, ($planet->getPlayer()?->getResearchLevel($machineName) ?? 0) + 1, $planet)
  433	            && $planet->hasResources($this->withReserve($planet, ObjectService::getObjectPrice($machineName, $planet), ReserveFloor::RESEARCH_HOURS));
  434	
  435	        if (!$queueable) {
  436	            return null;
  437	        }
  438	
  439	        return app()->makeWith(QueueableResearch::class, [
  440	            'planetId' => $planet->getPlanetId(),
  441	            'researchId' => $candidate->buildingId,
  442	            'reason' => $candidate->reason,
  443	        ]);

  453	    private function withReserve(PlanetService $planet, Resources $price, float $savingHours): Resources
